risk_summary: The target website is missing a Content-Security-Policy (CSP), which could potentially lead to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities if not properly configured.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
findings.remediation: Ensure that all user inputs are properly sanitized and validated before being used in SQL queries. Implement parameterized queries or prepared statements to prevent SQL injection attacks.
